description.en:
JAKA π is a compact bipedal humanoid for university education, commercial interaction, entertainment and companionship applications. Its child-sized body combines a movable head, articulated arms and legs, and an actuated waist for expressive movement and manipulation. JAKA presents walking, running, jumping and interactive demonstrations as part of the platform's intended use.

The product specification lists a height of 1.22 metres, weight of 42 kg and 27 active degrees of freedom. It includes a voice module, handheld controller and mobile application. The manufacturer's published speed, load and endurance figures describe its stated configuration rather than independently verified performance in every application.
